--services.help: List of services to be executed.

--session-duration.help: Assumed role session duration in seconds, must be between 900 and 43200. Default: 3600

--shodan.help: Check if any public IPs in your Cloud environments are exposed in Shodan. We recommend to use the SHODAN_API_KEY environment variable to provide the API key.

--skip-api-check.help: Assume all APIs are active and skip the active API check for each service

--skip-sh-update.help: Skip updating previous findings of Prowler in Security Hub

--skip_on_error.help: If check output is invalid json, error out instead of skipping the check

--slack.help: Send a summary of the execution with a Slack APP in your channel. Environment variables SLACK_API_TOKEN and SLACK_CHANNEL_NAME are required (see more in https://docs.prowler.com/user-guide/cli/tutorials/integrations#configuration-of-the-integration-with-slack/).

--sp-env-auth.help: Use Service Principal environment variables authentication to log in against Azure

--stackit-project-id.help: StackIT Project ID to audit (alternatively set via STACKIT_PROJECT_ID environment variable)

--stackit-region.help: STACKIT region(s) to scan (default: all available regions)

--stackit-service-account-key.help: Inline content of a StackIT service account key (JSON). Useful in CI/CD where the secret comes from a secret manager and you do not want to write it to disk. Prefer the STACKIT_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY environment variable over this flag to avoid leaking the key through process listings or shell history.

--stackit-service-account-key-path.help: Path to a StackIT service account key JSON file. The SDK signs the RSA challenge in the key and mints/refreshes access tokens internally for the life of the scan. Alternatively set via the STACKIT_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY_PATH environment variable.

--subscription-ids.help: Azure Subscription IDs to be scanned by Prowler

--tag-filter.help: Regex to filter tags during registry enumeration (re.search). Example: '^(latest|v\d+\.\d+\.\d+)$'

--tenant.help: Tenant id for which the data will be populated.

--tenant-id.help: Azure Tenant ID to be used with --browser-auth option

--trivy-severity.help: Filter Trivy findings by severity. Default: all severities. Available: CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW, UNKNOWN

--unix-timestamp.help: Set the output timestamp format as unix timestamps instead of iso format timestamps (default mode).

--use-instance-principal.help: Use OCI Instance Principal authentication (only works when running inside an OCI compute instance)

--verbose.help: Runs showing all checks executed and results
